Hi Sofia — thanks for the details and the attachments.

Quick plan from Redwood:
1) We can trigger a single manual retry against the same instrument once you confirm you'd like us to proceed. This will use the current routing (acquirer A) but with an extended auth window.
2) If the retry surfaces SCA (3DS) challenge, we have an SCA fallback link we can surface via email to the cardholder. KitePay will need to host the redirect or we can host a short checkout widget — which do you prefer?
3) If the payment cannot be collected, we recommend a card rotation flow; we can generate a short-lived update-card URL to include in your recovery email and track completion.

Notes/risks: the acquirer code suggests insufficient funds; a retry may succeed but could also trigger a chargeback window if the customer disputes. Recommend KitePay confirm willingness to accept that risk.

Action items:
- Sofia: confirm (a) approve one manual retry now and (b) whether KitePay wants Redwood to host SCA flow or host itself.
- Aditya/Marissa: please review and approve the one-time retry and any concession on chargeback liability.
